subject: Combining display and closed storage
hook: Cupboards below, shelves above: watch a combined alcove unit come together in the workshop.
ig:
Cupboards below, shelves above: watch a combined alcove unit come together in the workshop.

Alcove units are one of the most requested pieces we make, and the best ones do two jobs: closed storage for everyday clutter and open shelves for the things you want on show.

The build follows the same steps every time:
• Panels cut on the sliding table panel saw to suit the alcove
• Every visible shelf edge finished with ABS edging
• Rows of shelf-pin holes drilled on the boring machine, so the display shelves can be moved later
• Cupboards assembled with soft-close hinges as standard
• On site, fillers scribed to the wall, because alcoves are almost never square

All of it is assembled by us, in our Hanley workshop or on site where access needs it. No flat boxes, no instructions.

Thinking about the alcoves either side of your chimney breast? Send us a DM with a photo and we will share some ideas.
fb:
Those alcoves either side of the chimney breast are some of the most useful space in a living room, if they are planned properly.

This is a quick look at how we build a combined unit in our Hanley workshop: cupboards below for the everyday clutter, adjustable shelves above for books and favourite pieces. Panels are cut, edged and drilled for shelf pins, the cupboards are assembled with soft-close hinges, and on site the edges are scribed to the wall so there are no gaps.

If your alcoves are crying out for something better, have a look at what we make:
